name: Hardline
description:
Hardline MCP connects your notes from your phone calls and site meetings to Claude.

Use this MCP when you are looking to connect real time data from the jobsite into your tools and workflows.

- Writing a daily log: Pull the decisions, commitments, and delivery updates from today's calls straight into the log, instead of backfilling from memory hours later.

- Drafting an RFI or change order: Pull the field context behind it. What the architect approved, what the sub flagged, what changed on the call, all in the draft.

- Settling a "you told me to" dispute: Find who committed to what and when, with the exact call it came from. The contemporaneous record, on demand.

Hardline helps you connect valuable information and photos to the rest of your system.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hardline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hardline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.hardlineapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hardline MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardline lists 22 MCP tools, including create_contact, create_task, delete_contacts, delete_tasks, get_artifact, get_artifact_image, get_call, get_call_transcript, get_contact, get_daily_activity, get_follow_up_candidates, and get_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hardline?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hardline in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Hardline requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hardline is developed by Hardline AI Corp.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
